Returns tasks scheduled for today, overdue tasks, tasks with deadlines today/overdue, and tasks completed today. Grouped by project/area.
Returns tasks with inbox status that have no project, area, or scheduled date.
Returns tasks scheduled for the next 7 days grouped by day, plus a "later" group for tasks beyond that. Includes repeating rule templates.
Returns tasks with anytime status, grouped by project/area.
Returns tasks with someday status, grouped by project/area.

get.summary: Get tasks for a Project view
get.description: Returns tasks in a project grouped by headings, with backlog and completed today sections.

get.summary: Get tasks for an Area view
get.description: Returns tasks directly in the area (not in projects), someday tasks, and projects in the area.

parameters.name: active
parameters.description: When true, return only non-trashed tasks with active/null status

post.description: Reorder tasks by providing ordered task IDs and the context they belong to. Context types: inbox, today, upcoming, anytime, someday, logbook, trash, project, heading, area. For project/heading/area contexts, provide contextId. For upcoming, contextId is the date (YYYY-MM-DD).
Move a task from one section to another (e.g., between projects in Today view). This updates the task's parentId and reorders tasks in the destination section.
Restores a trashed task. If the task belongs to a completed or trashed project, returns an error.

400.description: Cannot restore - project is completed or trashed

post.description: Restores a completed/cancelled task from logbook. If the task belongs to a completed project, returns an error.
Marks all unlogged completed/cancelled tasks as logged. Logged tasks only appear in the logbook, not in 'completed today' sections.
